name: REGI D
description: DJ REGI D plays a set of minimal, progressive house, and tech house at Big Bad Bank Bar in Porto. Admission is free.
longDescription:
DJ REGI D brings a club night featuring minimal, progressive house, and tech house sounds to Big Bad Bank Bar at Zero Box Lodge, located at R. do Ateneu Comercial do Porto, 13.

The music starts at 23:00 on 30 November 2026 and runs until 02:00. Admission is free.
